## Outcome

Provide consistent navigation and search patterns for SDK docs, Bloxwap products, and native apps.

Roadmap: #1 · Milestone: M2: React and React Native components · Priority: P1 (required for v1).

## Scope

- Implement the audited Tabs, Accordion, Breadcrumb, Pagination, navigation items/sidebar, and Command/Search patterns; declare platform-specific applicability.
- Provide mobile bottom/navigation patterns and disclosure controls using native back/route semantics instead of importing a browser router into shared packages.
- Define active, hover, focus, selection, collapsed, empty search, async loading/error, and keyboard shortcut behavior.
- Keep router and search/index providers as host adapters; preserve deep links, query/state restoration, and a readable DOM/native accessibility structure.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Docs and product examples demonstrate current-location semantics, predictable disclosure, navigation, and search without coupling to a router.
- [ ] Keyboard navigation, focus restoration, screen-reader order, touch behavior, and long/translated labels are verified.
- [ ] The React/RN applicability matrix explicitly covers alternatives for browser-only patterns; supported native equivalents have real examples.

## Prerequisites

- #16 — Build dialogs, sheets, menus, and contextual overlays for React and RN

## References

- [Hyperliquid](https://github.com/bloxwap/hyperliquid/tree/main/apps/docs)
- [Chart](https://github.com/bloxwap/chart/tree/main/apps/docs)
- [Font](https://github.com/bloxwap/font/tree/main/apps/docs)
- [Appsite](https://bloxwap.app)
- [Prosite](https://bloxwap.pro)
- [Native](https://github.com/bloxwap/monorepo/tree/main/packages/ui-native)

## Completion evidence

Link implementation PRs, updated docs/examples, and relevant validation results. Record platform limitations and any remaining catalog/adoption work explicitly.
